Exactly the same object as the reference image, shown three times side by side from left to right: front view, right side view, back view. Same scale, same height, aligned on the same baseline, each view centered in its own equal-width panel with generous empty space between views. low poly 3D game asset, flat shading, faceted geometry, clean hard edges, limited color palette, orthographic projection, no perspective distortion, even flat studio lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no reflections, plain pure white background, object fully visible with margin, no ground plane, no text, no labels, no arrows
